title: Microscopic Insights into the Solvation of Stapled Peptides-A Case Study of p53-MDM2.
authors: Gaikwad, Vikram; Choudhury, Asha Rani; Chakrabarti, Rajarshi
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟研究订书肽溶剂化对p53-MDM2蛋白-蛋白互作的影响，虽涉及分子动力学方法，但对象为蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA体系关联较弱。
abstract: Water, often termed the universal solvent, plays a vital role in numerous biomolecular processes, including protein-protein interactions. These interactions are frequently mediated by water molecules, making their characterization essential for developing therapeutic strategies. One such critical complex is p53-MDM2, which is central to cellular regulation. Inhibiting the p53-MDM2 interaction remains a significant therapeutic challenge, and stapled peptides have emerged as promising candidates in this context. The stapled peptides are peptidomimetics in which the side chains of two suitably positioned amino acids are covalently linked using an appropriate chemical moiety. In this study, we investigate the role of water in the binding of stapled p53 peptides to MDM2 using extensive molecular dynamics simulations. Our aim is to understand how variations in the chemical nature and stapling position of the hydrocarbon cross-linker influence the behavior of water molecules surrounding the p53 peptide. We demonstrate that such modifications significantly alter the structure and dynamics of the surrounding solvent. Using rigorous entropy calculations, we rationalize the enhanced binding affinity of stapled p53 peptides compared to that of their unstapled counterparts from a solvent-centric perspective. Specifically, the entropy gain of water molecules around the stapled peptides, combined with the conformational entropy loss of the peptide, contributes favorably to binding. These findings offer valuable insights into the rational design of stapled peptides and support the development of improved therapeutic inhibitors targeting the p53-MDM2 interaction.
abstract_zh: 水，常被称为通用溶剂，在众多生物分子过程中扮演着关键角色，包括蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用。这些相互作用常由水分子介导，因此对其表征对于制定治疗策略至关重要。其中一个关键复合物是p53-MDM2，它在细胞调控中起核心作用。抑制p53-MDM2相互作用仍是治疗上的重大挑战，而订书肽（stapled peptides）在此背景下已成为有前景的候选分子。订书肽是拟肽类化合物，其中两个适当定位的氨基酸侧链通过合适的化学部分共价连接。在本研究中，我们利用广泛的分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟，探讨水在订书p53肽与MDM2结合中的作用。我们的目标是理解烃类交联剂的化学性质和订书位置的变化如何影响p53肽周围水分子的行为。我们证明，这些修饰显著改变了周围溶剂的结构和动力学。通过严格的熵计算，我们从溶剂中心视角合理化了订书p53肽相比未订书对应物增强的结合亲和力。具体而言，订书肽周围水分子的熵增益，结合肽的构象熵损失，对结合产生有利贡献。这些发现为订书肽的合理设计提供了宝贵见解，并支持开发针对p53-MDM2相互作用的改进治疗性抑制剂。
